text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A after a large gain, but that alone doesn't show whether selling was the right decision; I should base trades on risk and portfolio needs, not the urge to lock in a win.","My recent account gains don't predict future returns. Since prices move randomly, I should avoid treating past price changes as signals.","Buying four stocks in one period increased my exposure; I should consider diversification and keep enough cash, while following a consistent plan rather than reacting to short-term moves."]}
